newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish Foreign Minister's health improving.
newsitem.headline: Spanish Foreign Minister's health improving.

text.p: Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes was recovering on Sunday after suffering a mild heart attack on the Mediterranean holiday island of Ibiza.
Doctors said his condition was stable and the prognosis favourable.
A hospital statement said Matutes would most likely be transferred out of the intensive care ward on Monday.
He was admitted to hospital with chest pains on Saturday and suffered a "small magnitude" heart attack while in intensive care.
